title: This Tiny Bird Flies 44,000 Miles Every Year

scenes.text: One bird flies forty-four thousand miles every single year.
The Arctic tern nests in the far north, then flies to Antarctica and back.
Scientists strapped 1.4-gram trackers to 60 of them to prove it.
It takes a huge zigzag path to catch the best winds.
Over a 30-year life, that is about 1.5 million miles.
Three round trips to the Moon.

description:
The Arctic tern makes the longest migration of any animal ever tracked, about 44,000 miles a year on average.
A 2010 study used 1.4-gram geolocators on 60 birds, and over a 30-year lifetime a tern may fly around 1.5 million miles.
Which animal journey amazes you most? Tell us below.
